The '''XP-30 Speeder''' was used on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by [[water prospector]]s. It had room for a driver and a passenger. Equipped with a sizable cargo hold, the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] could hold at least three [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] cargo platforms loaded with water storage bladders. [[Mammon Hoole]] traveled in one of these vehicles with a local water prospector when he visited [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to write his planetary report.
